segments.text: This is the second video presentation for the case animal and plant biotechnology course.
segments.zh: 这是 CASE 动植物生物技术课程的第二个视频演示。

segments.text: As you view this video, be sure to make notes of important information.
segments.zh: 观看本视频时，请务必记下重要信息。

segments.text: Feel free to pause, repeat, and resume the video whenever necessary.
segments.zh: 必要时可以随时暂停、重播和继续播放视频。

segments.text: Plasmids and bacteria lessen 2.2 genetic transformers.
segments.zh: 质粒与细菌，第 2.2 课，基因转化者。

segments.text: You completed activity 2.2.1 transformation preparation,
segments.zh: 你已经完成了活动 2.2.1“转化准备”，

segments.text: during which you prepared media to use during bacterial transformation throughout the next few activities.
segments.zh: 在该活动中，你配制了在接下来几个活动的细菌转化中要用到的培养基。

segments.text: This presentation provides an overview of the process of transformation.
segments.zh: 本演示概述了转化的过程。

segments.text: It introduces plasmids and how they are utilized in genetic transformation.
segments.zh: 它介绍了质粒以及质粒如何用于遗传转化。

segments.text: Transformation is one method of modern genetic modification.
segments.zh: 转化是现代基因改造的一种方法。

segments.text: A transgenic organism has a genetic makeup containing DNA which was physically transferred from another organism.
segments.zh: 转基因生物的遗传组成中含有从另一种生物体实际转移过来的 DNA。

segments.text: Examples of transformed organisms include oil eating microbes, pest resistant crops, and pharmaceuticals from biopharming practices.
segments.zh: 转化生物的例子包括能分解石油的微生物、抗虫作物，以及通过生物制药农业生产的药物。

segments.text: Plasmids are extra chromosomal DNA arranged in a circular shape.
segments.zh: 质粒是呈环状排列的染色体外 DNA。

segments.text: Plasmid DNA does not interfere with the host chromosome functions.
segments.zh: 质粒 DNA 不会干扰宿主染色体的功能。

segments.text: Restriction enzymes are used to cut plasmids.
segments.zh: 限制性内切酶用于切割质粒。

segments.text: A single cut will open a plasmid molecule, making way for the insertion of new genetic material.
segments.zh: 切一刀就能打开一个质粒分子，为插入新的遗传物质让出位置。

segments.text: Once a plasmid molecule is closed, it will replicate within the host.
segments.zh: 质粒分子一旦重新闭合，就会在宿主体内复制。

segments.text: A bacteria takes up small pieces of DNA.
segments.zh: 细菌会摄取小片段的 DNA。

segments.text: The plasmid DNA may be expressed.
segments.zh: 质粒 DNA 可能会得到表达。

segments.text: During the next few activities, you will attempt to transform bacteria with the p-glo plasmid.
segments.zh: 在接下来的几个活动中，你将尝试用 pGLO 质粒转化细菌。

segments.text: The p-glo plasmid has two major functions, bioluminescence and ampicillin resistance.
segments.zh: pGLO 质粒有两个主要功能：生物发光和氨苄青霉素抗性。

segments.text: Bioluminescence, or the glowing characteristic, is a result of the addition of the green fluorescent protein, or GFP.
segments.zh: 生物发光，也就是发光的特性，是加入绿色荧光蛋白（GFP）的结果。

segments.text: In order to activate the GFP, a rabinose is required.
segments.zh: 要激活 GFP，需要阿拉伯糖。

segments.text: Bioluminescence indicates whether transformation has taken place.
segments.zh: 生物发光表明转化是否已经发生。

segments.text: The E. coli strain HB101 is a benign bacterial strain, not to be confused with the more dangerous strains.
segments.zh: 大肠杆菌 HB101 菌株是一种无害的细菌菌株，不要与那些更危险的菌株混淆。

segments.text: E. coli HB101 is widely used in research.
segments.zh: 大肠杆菌 HB101 在研究中被广泛使用。

segments.text: Non-transformed E. coli HB101 will not survive in the presence of ampicillin, a common antibacterial agent.
segments.zh: 未转化的大肠杆菌 HB101 在氨苄青霉素存在时无法存活，氨苄青霉素是一种常见的抗菌剂。

segments.text: In the media you prepared, you have various combinations of auger, ampicillin, p-glo plasmids, and a rabinose.
segments.zh: 在你配制的培养基中，有琼脂、氨苄青霉素、pGLO 质粒和阿拉伯糖的各种组合。

segments.text: Before you move on, take a moment to predict what will happen in each plate if bacterial transformation has taken place.
segments.zh: 在继续之前，花点时间预测一下，如果发生了细菌转化，每个平板上会出现什么情况。

segments.text: Will bacterial colonies form? Will the colonies exhibit GFP?
segments.zh: 会形成细菌菌落吗？菌落会表现出 GFP 吗？

segments.text: Pause the video to record predictions for all four plates in your notes.
segments.zh: 暂停视频，在笔记中记下你对全部四个平板的预测。

segments.text: Include notes regarding why you believe each outcome will happen.
segments.zh: 并写明你认为每种结果会发生的原因。

segments.text: Resume the video to compare your predictions with those of experts.
segments.zh: 继续播放视频，把你的预测与专家的预测进行比较。

segments.text: The first plate contains LB auger and no p-glo genetic material.
segments.zh: 第一个平板含有 LB 琼脂，没有 pGLO 遗传物质。

segments.text: There are no genetic modifications made to the culture on this plate.
segments.zh: 这个平板上的培养物没有进行任何基因改造。

segments.text: Anticipated results include heavy bacterial growth since LB auger is conducive to the growth of E. coli HB101.
segments.zh: 预期结果是细菌大量生长，因为 LB 琼脂有利于大肠杆菌 HB101 的生长。

segments.text: Because no p-glo genes are present, the bacteria should not exhibit GFP.
segments.zh: 由于没有 pGLO 基因，细菌应该不会表现出 GFP。

segments.text: The second plate contains LB auger, ampicillin, and no p-glo genetic material.
segments.zh: 第二个平板含有 LB 琼脂和氨苄青霉素，没有 pGLO 遗传物质。

segments.text: No modifications should take place on this plate.
segments.zh: 这个平板上应该不会发生任何改造。

segments.text: No growth is anticipated as this sample contains ampicillin, which inhibits the growth of E. coli HB101.
segments.zh: 预计不会有细菌生长，因为这个样品含有氨苄青霉素，它会抑制大肠杆菌 HB101 的生长。

segments.text: The third plate contains LB auger, ampicillin, and p-glo genetic material.
segments.zh: 第三个平板含有 LB 琼脂、氨苄青霉素和 pGLO 遗传物质。

segments.text: Genetic modifications should take place, but only a limited number of bacterial colonies will appear,
segments.zh: 应该会发生基因改造，但只会出现数量有限的细菌菌落，

segments.text: as not all will take up the plasmid to be resistant to ampicillin.
segments.zh: 因为并非所有细菌都会摄取质粒从而获得氨苄青霉素抗性。

segments.text: Although the modification will take place, the colonies will not exhibit bioluminescence as there is no activator.
segments.zh: 虽然会发生改造，但由于没有激活剂，菌落不会表现出生物发光。

segments.text: The final plate contains all treatments.
segments.zh: 最后一个平板包含所有处理成分。

segments.text: The presence of LB auger, ampicillin, arabinose, and p-glo genetic material
segments.zh: LB 琼脂、氨苄青霉素、阿拉伯糖和 pGLO 遗传物质同时存在，

segments.text: should result in a limited growth of bacteria that glow under UV light.
segments.zh: 应该会导致少量细菌生长，并在紫外灯下发光。

segments.text: In short, the plates with p-glo and ampicillin should express limited growth of bacteria.
segments.zh: 简而言之，含有 pGLO 和氨苄青霉素的平板应该会出现有限的细菌生长。

segments.text: Only the plate with arabinose used to activate the GFP should glow.
segments.zh: 只有加入了用于激活 GFP 的阿拉伯糖的平板才会发光。

segments.text: As a review, mark or highlight three key points in your notes that are important to remember.
segments.zh: 作为复习，请在笔记中标记或突出显示三个需要记住的要点。

segments.text: List two ideas or concepts that relate to previous knowledge.
segments.zh: 列出两个与已有知识相关的观点或概念。

segments.text: List any questions you have about this topic.
segments.zh: 列出你对这个主题的任何疑问。

segments.text: Discuss these with your instructor.
segments.zh: 与你的老师讨论这些问题。

segments.text: Keep any notes you have from this presentation organized and available for use throughout the course.
segments.zh: 把你在本演示中做的所有笔记整理好，以便在整个课程中随时使用。

segments.text: Through activity 2.2.2 Glowing Genes, you will transform bacterial cells to exhibit bioluminescence and ampicillin resistance
segments.zh: 通过活动 2.2.2“发光的基因”，你将转化细菌细胞，使其表现出生物发光和氨苄青霉素抗性，

segments.text: in order to understand how plasmids are used to ensure genetic material into bacteria.
segments.zh: 以了解如何利用质粒将遗传物质插入细菌。

segments.text: Your teacher will provide more instructions.
segments.zh: 你的老师会提供更多说明。
